results.title: A Complete List of All Adversarial Example Papers
results.content: A Complete List of All (arXiv) Adversarial Example Papers. It can be hard to stay up-to-date on the published papers in the field of adversarial examples, where we have seen massive growth in the number of papers written each year. I have been somewhat religiously keeping track of these papers for the last few years, and realized it may be helpful for others to release this list. The only requirement I used for selecting papers for this list is that it is primarily a paper about adversarial examples, or extensively uses adversarial examples. Due to the sheer quantity of papers, I can't guarantee that I actually have found *all* of them. For a curated list of papers that I think are excellent and worth reading, see the Adversarial Machine Learning Reading List. (98%)Zhifang Zhang; Jiahan Zhang; Shengjie Zhou; Qi Wei; Shuo He; Feng Liu; Lei Feng 3DGAA: Realistic and Robust 3D Gaussian-based Adversarial Attack for Autonomous Driving.
